units.rawText: What do you think the Oasis will be like in the future? To me right now, the Oasis is no longer just a foothold for us on Magrasea, but a refuge filled with countless precious memories.

units.rawText: When I was first uploaded to the cloud, I knew nothing about the future. In my cluelessness, I lost someone important to me... and so I continued fumbling my way forward, until I had to face loss once again.

units.rawText: It took a long, long time for me to find my direction and it's a good thing you were there to guide me all this time.

units.rawText: The truth is, even now, there are still many things I don't understand about you, and about the entire cloud.

units.rawText: But I won't lose my way any more. That's because of the friends that have already fallen, and the ones who are still by my side. No matter where the future may take me...
